business.source: captured page (corrects the search snippet, which said "sold with an online configurator")

human_note_verbatim: saya merasa permainan tipografi mereka sangat baik, permainan warna solid, font bold tebal dikombinasikan dengan text kecil yang ringan. Title dominan besar sehingga memberikan contrast dan membuat balance
permainan foto juga menjadi peranan penting

take.device: heavy bold display set very large against small light text

take.quality: not specified which colours or roles
not specified: lifestyle, product cut-out, children at play?

gaps_in_note: No business reason: the configurator is likely the page's key selling device and is not mentioned
Colour: which colours, in what proportion, and what each one does
Photography: what kind and what job it does (show scale? show children using it? show it in a real yard?)
'Contrast and balance' is an outcome; the measurable cause (size ratio, weight pair) is not given

claims.claim: Heavy bold title + small light text gives contrast and balance
claims.evidence: One family (Geograph), 234px wordmark vs 14-18px text, about 13:1. The small text is regular weight, not light. The big title is only the brand name and carries no offer; the one sentence saying what the product is fails contrast (1.70:1).
0 gradients; flat sand, yellow, black fields. The colours are the product's own colourways (swatch picker), which is why they work.
Real children on the fort in real gardens; the night shot beside a house answers "will it fit my garden". The first screen is a 3D render, and photos have no captions.

questions: Apa yang Anda maksud dengan "balance": komposisinya, atau perpaduan besar-kecilnya?
Anda tidak menyebut bahwa halaman ini tidak menjual (tanpa harga, hanya waitlist). Apakah tetap Anda nilai bagus untuk klien yang perlu menjual langsung?
entries.veto: Hero sentence white on sand #edbf7a = 1.70:1; 0 of 3144 characters render without JavaScript.
library_candidates: Palette = the product's colourways: flat section fields in the product finishes; a swatch picker recolours the product (opacity cross-fade 300ms) and tweens the page background (700ms). Function: the visitor starts owning a configuration.
Fit proof before the ask: a dimensioned drawing (mm) with a child silhouette + one plain sentence ("small enough for real gardens"), placed right before the sign-up.
Effort in human units: "assembled by two adults in a morning" instead of specs.
Two-tone stacked headline: line 1 full ink, line 2 same size in ~60% tone of the field colour, pairing aspiration with reassurance.
Name the fear as a heading ("Dangerously safe.") followed by a hard standard (ISO 8124-4).
avoid: Brand-name-only hero with no offer and no action
White or tinted text on mid-tone fields (1.14-1.70:1)
Transparent sticky logo colliding with body text
Promising a system ("endless ways to play") whose parts are all "Coming soon"
Vague CTA ("Get updates") on a high-ticket pre-order

owner.answers: "saya rasa betul" (agrees with the jury reading; which of the two questions was not stated)

human_note_verbatim: ini adalah website yang bagus juga, karena permainan mereka tidak mengandalkan gambar tapi mengandalkan object vector sederhana yang di animasikan, mengikuti dari bisnis
permainan font dengan ukuran dominan kecil memberikan kesan rapi, walaupun tidak bertema modern(rounded)

take.device: simple animated vector objects instead of photos
take.quality: follows the business (which business is not stated)

parsed.why_business: 'mengikuti dari bisnis' is claimed but the business is not named; cannot be checked yet

gaps_in_note: Which business, and how exactly the vector objects express it
What the animation does (feedback, explanation, atmosphere) and when it runs
'Small type looks neat' needs a check: running text under 16px or low contrast costs readability, especially on phones
'Not modern (rounded)': rounded is one style, not the definition of modern; say what the type is (grotesk, mono, serif) instead

claims.evidence: No photography on any screen; imagery is document facsimiles, isometric blocks, texture.
Dense, textured, isometric stacks of realistic documents; 121 animated elements. Not simple and not flat vector.
The visuals show the very records being licensed (emails, Jira, transcripts, redaction). Exceptions: the blue tunnel and the closing collage are decoration.
Headlines are large serifs (72px desktop, 42px mobile); 14-16 font sizes; text at 2-8px and running text at 14px; grey proof captions 2.26-3.41:1.
"Rounded" is one style, not the definition of modern. The look is editorial: serif display, grotesk body, mono labels, visible dashed grid.

questions: "Ukuran dominan kecil" maksudnya label-label kecil (mono) di sekitar visual, atau teks body? Headline-nya justru besar (72px).
Yang Anda sebut "vektor sederhana" ternyata tumpukan dokumen yang detail. Apakah yang Anda suka justru teksturnya, atau gerakannya?
entries.veto: Readable copy at 2-8px and grey text down to 2.26:1; the price bands stay hidden on phones and under reduced motion.
library_candidates: Objection ladder for a novel offer: sections in the order the buyer's fears arrive (what counts, how much, how much effort, is it safe, who buys it, do I qualify).

Self-locating price anchor: bands by a variable the buyer knows ("20-50 employees: $10K-$100K") so the CTA confirms a number rather than starting a sales call. Keep the numbers visible without animation.
Effort in minutes: "Four steps. 120 minutes of your time."
Reframe against known alternatives: equity costs ownership, debt must be repaid, revenue takes time.
House-curve reveal: clip-path wipe 270-470ms, cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), 55ms stagger; one curve for the whole site.
Three faces, three jobs: editorial serif display, neutral grotesk body, mono for labels.
avoid: Key numbers that only appear through scroll animation
No named proof on a high-risk ask
A 15s auto-advancing carousel with no pause

owner.answers: likes both the texture and the motion; "small type" meant both the mono labels and the body

gaps_in_note: Note 2 is cut off ('ketika di scrolldown akan ada ...'): what happens on scroll?
Dark palette: why it suits this business (liquor retail, evening trade?) or whether it is only taste
Which colour is the accent and where it is used

claims.evidence: Black canvas + one chromatic accent (#f54900). It suits spirits, but dims the trust line (3.66:1) and the main button (3.60:1).
They are high-fidelity product screens, not wireframes, filled with real whisky and wine SKUs and stock flags. All jurors call this the strongest part: it proves "built for liquor".

Observed live: the header hides on scroll (300ms); the main motion is a scroll story where "old way" paper props fly out (to 250px, 50deg), a sentence lights up word by word, then the clean product screen fades in.

questions: Catatan kedua terpotong: apakah yang Anda maksud adegan "old way" yang berterbangan saat scroll, atau header yang bersembunyi?
entries.veto: No prefers-reduced-motion handling (scroll rotations to 50deg/250px, endless rotating waves, unpausable marquees); primary CTA white on #f54900 = 3.60:1.
library_candidates: Product UI filled with the buyer's own world (real SKUs, stock flags) in the hero: proof of the vertical by detail.
Old way vs new way with the buyer's own artefacts (90s dialog, paper invoice, sticky note), animated away on scroll into the clean screen. Function: story.
Peer proof in the buyer's setting: named owners with store names, filmed in their shops, right after the hero.
Black + one hot accent used only for the action, links and alerts (darken the orange to ~#c23a00 for white text).
Scroll-scrubbed word reveal at 30-45px, words resting at 40% opacity.
avoid: Dropping the main action for most of the scroll (non-sticky header, only "Find out more" links)
Problem stated after the feature menu
Endless loops and big scroll motion with no reduced-motion fallback
The generic dark-SaaS hero kit (pill eyebrow, centred headline, two CTAs)

owner.answers: the scroll note meant the flying "old way" papers
